svg.title: Thirty measured, eight hundred hoped for
svg.desc: Eight hundred small circles arranged in a block, one for every student in the school. Thirty of them in the top left corner are filled in dark and ringed with a dashed box labelled you measured this bit. The other seven hundred and seventy are empty outlines.
svg.text: You measured 30. You are talking about 800.
800 students in the school — the POPULATION
One person in your sample stands for 27 people.
And your 30 all sit in one corner, which is exactly the problem.
